baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُلْ هَٰذِهِۦ سَبِيلِىٓ أَدْعُوٓا۟ ... وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِى
baseline_models.mechanism: Voiced speech identifies an extended route, the call inclines hearers toward its divine terminus, and following turns hearers into walkers. The utterance is therefore a public movement with a direction, not only a proposition.

activation_trace.role: Vocalized speech supplies the public articulation that exposes the route.
The extended traversable road makes the announced commitment a practicable course.
Calling and inclining by speech supplies the directional recruitment into that course.
Following behind converts the route from an individual claim into a walkable succession.

changed_reading.before: The speaker states his religious position and asks others to accept it.
changed_reading.after: The speaker publicly opens a directed route whose truth is enacted by calling and by people actually proceeding behind him.

baseline_models.mechanism: Insight is not merely private certainty possessed by the first caller. Its placement beside both the first-person subject and the follower supports a reproducible discipline: followers retrace evidence and remain participants in discerning rather than becoming an unseeing tail.

activation_trace.role: Penetrating heart-sight supplies verified inward discernment as the platform of the call.
Tracing an effect step by step makes following an investigative continuation of insight.
The people of the road supply a social body whose members share the route rather than merely admire it.

changed_reading.before: The leader knows; followers accept his knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The call establishes a shared practice of sighted following in which transmitted allegiance remains answerable to retraced signs.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ... وَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The destination in God is followed by an act of clearing God of attribution and then by refusal of divine partnership. The route contains a negative operation as well as a positive summons: every rival share is removed from the destination.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped one supplies both the call's terminus and the referent being cleared of rivals.
Clearing and exonerating performs the route's active purification of its divine destination.
Association with God names the negated rival-sharing that would split the route's terminus.

changed_reading.before: The verse invites to God and then adds a conventional denial of polytheism.
changed_reading.after: Invitation and purification are one mechanism: movement toward God continually strips the destination of every attributed co-owner.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence makes insight a capacity that can register a faint sign before social confirmation, endure being named old error, and later become embodied sight and disclosed knowledge. Basira in the focus is thus tested perception carried through a hostile interval, not confidence certified by consensus.

activation_trace.role: Finding and hitting upon something supplies the initial recognition of an otherwise unconfirmed trace.
Scent and smelling make the first evidence real yet thin, mobile, and easy for others to dismiss.
Deviation from guidance supplies the social counter-reading imposed on the perceiver.
News that opens the surface with joy supplies a bearer who converts the faint sign into arrival.
Return to a prior state supplies restoration rather than acquisition of an unrelated faculty.
Recovered ocular seeing externalizes and vindicates the earlier inward recognition.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the explicit asymmetry between insight and the crowd's present knowledge.
Heart-sight anchors the restored-sight sequence back in the focus call's epistemic platform.

structural_cues: 12:94-96 moves in order from private scent-recognition, through dismissal as old error, to returned sight and the contrast between what one party knows and others do not.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies faint scent, ridicule, a herald, restored seeing, and contrasted knowledge; I infer that their sequence models insight surviving pre-consensus testing. A live alternative is that the restoration is only a singular miracle and does not specify the ordinary posture of 12:108.

changed_reading.before: Calling on insight means speaking from settled, publicly defensible certainty.
changed_reading.after: Calling on insight can mean faithfully carrying a weak but real recognition through ridicule until its evidential world becomes visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The realized dream gathers prison, reunion, hidden delicacy, present submission, and future joining into one retrospectively legible trajectory. 'This is my path' can therefore condense a life whose route becomes visible by its outcome while still extending beyond achieved power toward surrendered death and righteous company.

activation_trace.role: Return to an outcome supplies retrospective convergence, letting earlier fragments disclose their route at the end.
The dream supplies an early image whose meaning only the traversed life eventually realizes.
Stable correspondence with reality marks the point where the latent route becomes retrospectively verifiable.
Passage to the outside supplies a concrete transition in the lived route.
Confinement supplies the obstructed interior from which the route nevertheless proceeds.
Minute hidden operation supplies the unobtrusive continuity joining apparently disconnected episodes.
Handing over and releasing supplies the route's posture after worldly arrival.
The later one reaching those ahead extends the path toward posthumous affiliation.
The traversable road anchors the biographical sequence as a possible expansion of 'my path.'

structural_cues: 12:100 explicitly reviews separated episodes as the realization of an earlier vision, while 12:101 turns from attained kingdom toward death in submission and joining the righteous.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outcome, dream, prison-exit, hidden delicacy, surrender, and later joining; I supply the arrow that 'my path' compresses this whole temporal itinerary. A live alternative is that the possessive path in 12:108 names only the speaker's present method of proclamation.

changed_reading.before: 'My path' is a present doctrinal method detached from the story just completed.
changed_reading.after: 'My path' is also the story-shaped trajectory by which hidden transitions become legible in retrospect and remain open toward surrendered completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to speak is immediately prepared by news from an unseen scene cast secretly to one who was not present. The focus voice is therefore not self-originating expertise: public utterance relays received witness across an absence that ordinary observation could not cross.

activation_trace.role: An arriving, transmitted report supplies the content that the later command to speak relays.
Concealment from eyes supplies the observational gap that reception must bridge.
Knowledge cast in hidden fashion supplies the inward reception behind the public voice.
A resolved plan gathered from dispersed opinions supplies the inaccessible human scene nevertheless reported.
Outward speech anchors hidden reception in the focus's commissioned public utterance.

structural_cues: 12:102 stresses both the addressee's absence from the plotters and the transmission of their unseen episode before 12:108 opens with an imperative to speak.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unseen news, hidden conveyance, absence, and then commanded speech; I infer a reception-to-relay direction. A live alternative is that 12:102 authenticates only the preceding story while 12:108 begins a separately grounded declaration.

changed_reading.before: 'Say' introduces the speaker's own lucid religious judgment.
changed_reading.after: 'Say' is the public edge of a hidden reception: insight speaks as relayed witness rather than autonomous authorship.

context_deltas.mechanism: Extreme desire cannot manufacture belief, and the address requests no payment. The call is accountable for lucid direction and reminder, not for controlling uptake or extracting value; its success cannot be measured simply by conversion count or compensation.

activation_trace.role: Excess appetite supplies the caller's maximum pressure of desire while still failing to produce the result.
Heart-settling assent supplies the response that eagerness alone cannot compel.
Compensation for work supplies the explicitly absent transactional motive.
A reminder that reactivates awareness supplies the positive function left when payment and control are removed.
Inclining by speech anchors the context's non-coercive and non-transactional function in the focus verb.

structural_cues: 12:103 denies majority belief even under intense eagerness; 12:104 immediately denies a requested wage and recasts the message as reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed eagerness, absent wage, and reminder; I infer that fidelity of invitation is independent of outcome control and exchange. A live alternative is that these verses defend sincerity without defining the mechanics of the call itself.

changed_reading.before: The call aims to secure belief, with low uptake appearing as practical failure.
changed_reading.after: The call offers lucid direction without purchase, force, or ownership of response; remembrance can be its faithful act even when most decline.

context_deltas.mechanism: The world is crossed as a field of visible markers, yet motion can coexist with turning one's side away. Path and insight in the focus combine into attentive passage: the relevant contrast is not moving versus standing still, but traversing while reading versus traversing while refusing encounter.

activation_trace.role: A manifest marker supplies the readable object distributed through the traveled world.
Going past and crossing supplies motion that can remain epistemically empty.
Turning the side away supplies the bodily geometry of refusing a sign while still passing it.
The extended road anchors the context's passing movement in the announced path.
Penetrating discernment supplies the attention that converts transit into sign-reading.

structural_cues: 12:105 places abundant signs, spatial passage over them, and bodily turning-away in one construction immediately before the focus announces a path upon insight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies signs, passage, and aversion; I infer that basira interrupts inattentive transit and makes walking interpretive. A live alternative is that 12:105 diagnoses culpable neglect without positively defining the path in 12:108.

changed_reading.before: Insight is a stock of correct knowledge carried along a path.
changed_reading.after: Insight is the manner of passage itself: sustained responsiveness that prevents a traveled, sign-filled world from becoming unseen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context places assent to God and association in the same majority subject. The focus's refusal of association therefore need not only draw a border against an external class; it can name an internal discipline that detects and removes rival shares from belief that already calls itself belief.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the real belief within which the verse nevertheless locates contamination.
General participation and shared ownership expose association as an admixture rather than only a separate label.
Association with God fixes the admixture specifically at the divine destination of belief.
The speaker's refusal anchors the contextual mixture as a live purification claim inside the focus.

structural_cues: 12:106 coordinates believing in God and associating within the same people; 12:108 then ends with a first-person refusal to belong among associators.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grammatical co-presence of belief and association, followed by self-disassociation; I infer a reflexive purification practice. A live alternative is a purely classificatory contrast in which the mixed majority and the speaker remain fixed external groups.

changed_reading.before: 'I am not among the associators' mainly identifies the speaker against unbelieving outsiders.
changed_reading.after: The declaration also audits belief from within, refusing the rival shares that can inhabit an otherwise genuine confession of God.

context_deltas.mechanism: An event can already be capable of total envelopment while arriving without warning to people lacking fine awareness. The focus's insight and call acquire temporal force: they cultivate perception before an irreversible horizon becomes sensible by impact.

activation_trace.role: A covering that generalizes over what it reaches supplies the event's enveloping spatial scale.
Abrupt surprise supplies the temporal discontinuity against which prior alertness matters.
Fine-grained awareness supplies precisely the faculty negated at the moment of surprise.
Heart-sight anchors anticipatory awareness in the focus's explicit epistemic stance.
The voiced summons becomes an intervention before surprise rather than a description after impact.

structural_cues: 12:107 pairs encompassing arrival and sudden arrival with the victims' lack of awareness; 12:108 answers immediately with a call grounded in insight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies envelopment, suddenness, and absent awareness; I infer that the following call trains anticipatory perception. A live alternative is that 12:107 supplies threat and urgency without changing the semantic work of basira.

changed_reading.before: The call communicates timeless truth to people who may accept or reject it.
changed_reading.after: The call also works against perceptual lateness, awakening fine awareness before a hidden horizon becomes an enveloping event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The followers of the focus join a prior procession of embodied messengers from inhabited settlements and are told to travel, direct sight and insight, inspect outcomes, and let reason restrain error. Following is therefore historical fieldwork as well as allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message supply the historical predecessors whose route the focus continues.
Walking on feet sharpens the messengers' stated humanity into embodied movement through the world.
People gathered in settlements supply the ordinary social locations from which messengers emerge.
Going and flowing supply the commanded field movement through which historical evidence is encountered.
Directing eye or insight toward an object supplies deliberate inspection during travel.
The last part and outcome supply the historical evidence the traveler is to read.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the discipline for converting observed outcomes into guidance.
Following behind anchors the historical procession in the focus's explicitly shared agency.
Travelers and people of the road give the procession a collective path-bearing identity.

structural_cues: 12:109 places human messengers from settlements before an imperative to travel and inspect prior outcomes, then asks whether the audience will reason.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies embodied messengers, settlements, travel, inspection, outcomes, and reason; I infer that followers inherit an evidence-seeking historical practice. A live alternative is that the travel command addresses skeptics rather than defining the followers in 12:108.

changed_reading.before: 'Whoever follows me' denotes people who assent to the speaker.
changed_reading.after: Followers enter an embodied historical procession whose allegiance includes travel, observation, comparison of outcomes, and disciplined inference.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger sequence reaches severed hope and an unstable attribution of falsehood before help and separation into safety arrive. Insight in the focus cannot simply mean uninterrupted subjective assurance; it can name a path held through a crisis in which the evidence is experienced as nearly collapsing.

activation_trace.role: The cutting off of hope supplies the extreme affective limit reached by messengers.
An outcome that cannot be trusted supplies live epistemic instability rather than calm certainty.
Attribution of falsehood supplies the crisis's contested relation between message, messenger, and audience.
Aid that makes manifest supplies the reversal that does not erase the prior interval.
Escape by separation supplies the concrete outcome of the late reversal.
Heart-sight anchors the crisis sequence as a revision of what insight can phenomenologically include.
Unbroken succession supplies fidelity across the interval even when felt confidence is discontinuous.

structural_cues: 12:110 delays aid until after messenger despair and a syntactically live crisis over who takes whom to be false, then narrates aid and rescue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies despair, uncertain attribution of falsehood, then help and rescue; I infer that sighted following may persist without uninterrupted felt certainty. A live alternative, preserved by the compact wording of كُذِبُوا۟, assigns the falsehood judgment differently and changes whose epistemic crisis is foregrounded.

changed_reading.before: To stand upon insight is to remain continuously certain and emotionally unshaken.
changed_reading.after: Insight can be fidelity through an evidential crisis: the route remains a route even when hope breaks and the message's reception is experienced as unstable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing verse presents tracked narrative as an apparatus for crossing from a sequence of traces to an analogous understanding, while denying fabrication and naming detailed guidance. The focus path upon insight is thus performed by the surah's story-form: one learns the way by following effects until they carry the reader across.

activation_trace.role: Tracking an effect supplies the narrative method of following evidence through time.
Sequentially conducting a report supplies the ordered form that preserves causal and temporal relations.
Passing from one side to another supplies the transfer from narrated particulars to changed understanding.
Making one condition instruct another supplies the story's explicit analogical work.
Invented falsehood supplies the rejected alternative to evidence-bearing narrative.
Detail that exposes parts and meanings supplies the articulation needed for a trace to teach.
Gentle indication toward road and truth names the directional result of narrative crossing.
Stepwise trace-following anchors the closing story apparatus in the focus's account of following.
Penetrating discernment supplies the changed understanding produced by the narrative crossing.

structural_cues: 12:111 gives the story an audience of possessors of cores, denies that it is fabricated discourse, and coordinates confirmation, detailing, guidance, and mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies traced story, crossing-lesson, non-fabrication, detail, and guidance; I infer that this narrative sequence enacts the focus's path of insight. A live alternative is that the closing verse only lists benefits of the story rather than specifying the method of 12:108.

changed_reading.before: The story illustrates a path whose principles could be stated independently of narrative.
changed_reading.after: The story is itself a path-making instrument: following its traces carries the reader across from events to insight without collapsing their detail.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The non-dominant split mapping is form-distant and must not be offered as the lexical meaning of أَدْعُو. It remains anchored in that focus root's packet inventory and usefully exposes a contrast between verbal inclination and forceful displacement; downstream prose should mark it as a contrastive activation only.

activation_trace.role: Calling and inclining by speech supplies the actual invitation mechanism.
The split branch's violent shove supplies the rejected coercive counter-mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Calling is generically causing others to move toward the goal.
changed_reading.after: The packet's split inventory makes the call legible, contrastively, as movement invited by voiced inclination rather than bodies or wills shoved into place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The milk image is materially surprising and should never replace the ordinary sense of calling. It remains anchored in the focus verb and gains functional contact with the explicitly succeeding followers; downstream prose should present it as an organic analogy for a call that leaves enough living remainder to draw a later flow.

activation_trace.role: Milk left behind to summon what follows supplies a material model of generative remainder.
Continuous succession supplies the later flow drawn out by the initiating remainder.

changed_reading.before: The caller emits a complete message that later followers merely repeat.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the call leaves a productive remainder within the community that draws subsequent acts of calling into continuity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading the road through an eye-disease branch is branch-distant and must be qualified as wordplay-like activation, not translation. It remains unusually well anchored because سَبِيل and بَصِيرَة occur in the same focus construction; downstream prose may use it only to picture how a route can be present yet perceptually webbed over.

activation_trace.role: A woven film over the eye supplies a surprising obstruction that hides an otherwise present way.
Heart-sight supplies the penetrating faculty by which the occluded route becomes traversable.

changed_reading.before: The path is objectively clear and rejection is simply refusal to enter it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the path may lie under a perceptual mesh; insight is not only knowing the destination but clearing enough occlusion to see a present road.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The activation depends on the non-dominant س م و to و س م mapping and is therefore unsuitable as a direct gloss of 'heavens.' It remains packet-anchored at 12:105 and coheres with the verse's explicit signs and the focus's insight; downstream prose should label the heavens-as-marked-surface image as exploratory.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ, activated by the signs passed in 12:105

activation_trace.role: A visible impressed mark makes the elevated field readable as a sign-bearing surface.
The manifest sign supplies the verse's explicit warrant for treating that surface as marked.
Penetrating discernment supplies the reader capable of recognizing marks rather than passing beneath them.

changed_reading.before: The heavens and earth contain separate signs that an observer may notice.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the elevated world is itself a marked surface, and basira is literacy in impressions that ordinary transit leaves unread.

strongest_changes: The restored-sight sequence turns basira into recognition that can precede consensus and survive ridicule.
Failed eagerness and absent payment separate faithful calling from control of uptake and transaction.
Belief mixed with association turns the final disavowal into an internal purification discipline as well as an external boundary.
Travel, inspection, outcomes, and reason make following an embodied historical practice rather than assent alone.
The closing story makes trace-following and analogical crossing part of how the path generates insight.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly changed static nouns into temporal practices: sight is restored, a life becomes legible at its outcome, hidden news becomes public speech, travelers either read or turn away, and story carries readers across. Split mappings and material branches also preserved live contrasts between invitation and force, complete message and generative remainder, visible road and perceptual veil.
remaining_uncertainties: The attachment scope of أَنَا۠ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِى leaves open how explicitly the grammar distributes basira across caller and followers.
The biographical reading of 'my path' is strongly sequenced but may exceed a narrower reference to the present prophetic method.
The compact wording around falsehood in 12:110 preserves competing assignments of the epistemic crisis.
The split-root and material outliers are mechanism-bearing analogies, not stable lexical paraphrases.
